Heading: Simple Parameter
Description: This column contains the most basic groupings of parameter names. It has five possible values: resource growth rate, resource carrying capacity, mortality rate, consumption rate, and conversion efficiency

Heading: Specific Metric
Description: Describes what metric is being used under the more general groupings in Simple Parameter. eg. attack rate as a specific metric for consumption rate

Heading: Reference
Description: The full reference for where the data in a row was obtained. May include a second reference for where the activation energy was reported, if this is not the same as the original paper.

Heading: Experiment Type
Description: Lab or field (our dataset is exclusively lab experiments)

Heading: Environment
Description: Freshwater, marine or terrestrial, or milk (in the case of bacteria found in milk)

Heading: General Taxon/Grouping 1
Description: Usually a common name for a higher taxon (or non-taxonomic group) that the focal species belongs to, such as "Mosquito", "Aphid", "Fish", etc.

Heading: General Taxon/Grouping 2
Description: Usually a common name for a higher taxon (or non-taxonomic group) that the focal species belongs to, such as "Mosquito", "Aphid", "Fish", etc. More granual than Grouping 1

Heading: General Taxon/Grouping 3
Description: Usually a common name for a higher taxon (or non-taxonomic group) that the focal species belongs to, such as "Mosquito", "Aphid", "Fish", etc. More granular than Grouping 2

Heading: Heterotroph or Autotroph
Description: A binary category (sorry, mixotrophs!) that categorizes the focal species as either a heterotroph if it consumes other organisms, or an autotroph if it photosynthesizes

Heading: Species
Description: The latin name of the focal species

Heading: Life Stage
Description: Details what life stage the focal species is in at the time of measurement. Typically adult or juvenile

Heading: Resource General
Description: Analogous to "General Taxon/Grouping" but with regards to the resource species. Is left empty if the focal species is already a resource species in the dataset, or if not available/applicable

Heading: Resource Species
Description: The latin name of the resource species

Heading: Resource Life Stage
Description: Analogous to "Life Stage" but with regards to the resource species (if present)

Heading: Max Temp
Description: The maximum temperature used in the calculation of the activation energy (°C)

Heading: Min Temp
Description: The minimum temperature used in the calculation of the activation energy (°C)

Heading: Temp Range
Description: The range of temperatures over which the activation energy was calculated. Calculated as max temp - min temp (°C)

Heading: Number of Temps Measured
Description: The number of distinct temperature treatments represented within the Temp Range

Heading: Activation Energy
Description: The value of the activation energy in eV

Heading: Error
Description: The value of any error estimate (standard error, confidence interval, etc.) on the activation energy, if given. Units are eV

Heading: Error Metric
Description: Which metric the Error value represents. SE (standard error), 95% CI, etc.

Heading: Model Used
Description: This column gives the name of the model used to calculate the activation energy.

Heading: Where to find in paper
Description: Shows where in the paper the activation energy (or raw data, if we calculated E ourselves in this analysis) is from.
